observations: Photo 0: one adult bicycle with a black frame and red graphics on the down tube, standing on a concrete yard with stacked tyres behind it.
Photo 0: thin road-size wheels with narrow tyres, a straight handlebar with red grips held by a hand.
Photo 0: a rear derailleur and what looks like a multi-ring front chainset are visible, so it has gears.
Photo 0: the brand text on the down tube is too small and blurred to read; a faint watermark crosses the frame.
Photo 0: the image is small and low resolution; shifters, brakes, tyre wear, rust and the frame size are not readable.
No clip of it being ridden or of the gears changing.

identity.kind: adult road bicycle with flat handlebar, multi-speed gears

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a rear derailleur and a front chainset, but the cogs and chainrings cannot be counted at this size.
The handlebar is shown but the shifters are not visible at this resolution.
Frame tubes look fairly thick but nothing shows the material; no frame sticker or magnet test.
A sales opinion; no ride clip.

risks.risk: Gears or shifters do not change cleanly, or the derailleur is bent.
risks.proof: A clip riding or turning the pedals on a stand while shifting through all front and rear gears.

risks.risk: Frame is steel, not aluminium, or is cracked or rusted at the joints.
risks.proof: Close photos of the frame joints and a clip of a magnet held against the down tube.
risks.if_unproven: as a steel frame of an unknown brand

risks.risk: Brakes, tyres or wheel rims are worn or out of true.
risks.proof: Close photos of both brakes and tyre treads, and a clip spinning each wheel.
risks.if_unproven: as needing new tyres and brakes

risks.proof: A photo of the frame serial number under the bottom bracket and any purchase receipt.

proof_requests: Clip riding the bicycle and changing through all gears.
Close photo of the brand on the down tube and the serial number under the bottom bracket.
Close photos of the shifters, brakes and tyres.
Clip of a magnet held against the frame.
response.reason: It is clearly an adult road-wheeled bicycle with gears, so it can be priced by type at its worst case as an unbranded steel bike with gears not working. A readable brand, a gear clip and a magnet test would raise it.
